results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Retrieve owner directory using HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNERS (build canonical owner_id→display-fields map; normalize owner_id to string for joins).

[Optional (if starting from a user-provided identifier)] [Next Step]: Resolve candidate owner by locally matching against HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNERS results; if ambiguous, return multiple candidates for selection.

[Optional (if confirming one candidate or identifier type is unclear)] [Next Step]: Fetch details using HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNER_BY_ID_OR_USER_ID (try owner id vs user id via idProperty; include archived=true when needed).

[Optional (if results look truncated/incomplete or archived owners are required)] [Step]: Paginate using HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_PAGE_OF_CRM_OWNERS (follow paging.next.after until absent; de-dupe by owner id).

[Optional (if results are empty/unexpected or access seems restricted)] [Fallback]: Verify context and permissions using HUBSPOT_GET_ACCOUNT_INFO and HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES before retrying owner reads.
known_pitfalls: [HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNERS] Owner records are under response.data.results; mis-parsing the response shape can look like an empty directory.
[HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_PAGE_OF_CRM_OWNERS] Cursor pagination uses paging.next.after and limit max 100; stop when paging.next is absent and de-dupe by owner id.
[HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNER_BY_ID_OR_USER_ID] Wrong idProperty (owner id vs user id) can yield 400 or failed lookups; retry with archived=true on 404 for inactive owners.
[HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES] Missing/insufficient scopes can surface as 401/403 or unexpectedly empty reads; confirm scopes before repeated retries.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=hubspot. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="hubspot") to create a connection BEFORE executing any hubspot tools.

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNERS.description: Retrieves a list of all owners in the HubSpot CRM, including their ID, first name, last name, email, and user ID.

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_PAGE_OF_CRM_OWNERS.description: Retrieves a paginated list of CRM owners from HubSpot, optionally filtering by email or archived status.

after.description: Pagination token from a previous response to fetch the next page.

email.description: Filter by a specific email address.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM owners per page. Refer to HubSpot's API documentation for current limits.

archived.description: Set to `true` for archived owners, or `false` for active owners.

HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNER_BY_ID_OR_USER_ID.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot CRM owner by their ID, with options to specify ID type (owner or user) and to include archived records.

ownerId.description: Unique identifier of the owner. Its meaning (HubSpot owner ID or user ID) is determined by `idProperty`.

archived.description: Set to `true` to retrieve only archived owners; otherwise, active (non-archived) owners are returned.

idProperty.description: Determines if `ownerId` refers to the HubSpot owner ID (`id`) or the user ID (`userId`).
